script = """
import json

marathon_km = 42.195
perigee_km = 356400  # Minimum perigee value on the Wikipedia page for the Moon (356,400 km)

# Kipchoge's world record times
# 2022 Berlin Marathon World Record: 2:01:09
# 2018 Berlin Marathon World Record: 2:01:39
# INEOS 1:59 Challenge: 1:59:40.2 (1:59:40)

times = {
    "2:01:09 (2022 WR)": 2 + 1/60 + 9/3600,
    "1:59:40.2 (INEOS)": 1 + 59/60 + 40.2/3600,
    "2:01:39 (2018 WR)": 2 + 1/60 + 39/3600
}

for name, t in times.items():
    speed_kmh = marathon_km / t
    hours = perigee_km / speed_kmh
    thousand_hours = hours / 1000
    print(f"=== {name} ===")
    print(f"Speed: {speed_kmh:.6f} km/h")
    print(f"Hours: {hours:.2f}")
    print(f"Thousand hours: {thousand_hours:.6f}")
    print(f"Nearest thousand hours: {round(thousand_hours)}")
"""

res = await run_command(f"python3 -c '{script}'")
print(res)
